description.en: The root path of the API.
Specifies whether to enable tag verification.

description.zh: API分组 ID，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh: API组名称中，可指定的关键字
description.en: The keyword that can be specified in the name of the API group.

description.zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值50，默认值为10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
排序，默认值是desc，可选asc，desc
- asc：按修改时间升序排列；
- desc：按修改时间降序排列
description.en:
The order. Valid values: asc and desc. Default value: desc.

*   asc: The API groups are displayed in ascending order of modification time.
*   desc: The API groups are displayed in descending order of modification time.

title.zh: 查询 API 分组列表

descriptions.en: *   This operation is intended for API providers.
